milestones.name: Enter Haven
milestones.note: Pastel purple/lavender outdoor ruins area with glowing flora, visible in first keyframe

milestones.name: Enter Metropolis
milestones.note: Dark blue-grey industrial/mechanical interior area with floating platforms, visible in second keyframe

milestones.name: Cross-area ability progression
milestones.note: Abilities obtained in Haven are used to unlock paths in Metropolis and vice versa; white map lines indicate locked traversal points

zones.name: Haven
zones.fingerprintHint: Pastel purple/lavender palette, organic ruins, glowing blue flora, large curved stone arches, warm ambient light
zones.note: First keyframe zone; abilities obtained here are used to progress in Metropolis

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark blue-grey palette, gridded metal walls, floating ice/stone platforms, red flora accents, glowing white platform seams
zones.note: Second keyframe zone; abilities obtained here are used to progress in Haven

abilities.name: Haven Ability
abilities.grants: Access to new paths in Metropolis
abilities.note: Generic reference — segment does not name the specific ability; white lines on map indicate newly accessible routes

abilities.name: Metropolis Ability
abilities.grants: Access to new paths in Haven
abilities.note: Generic reference — segment does not name the specific ability; white lines on map indicate newly accessible routes

objectives.name: Use cross-area abilities to unlock blocked paths
objectives.hopDescription: If stuck in Haven or Metropolis, fast-travel to the other area and check white map lines for newly accessible routes using your latest ability.
objectives.note: Core exploration tip: the two main areas are mutually dependent for progression

connectors.description: Fast travel between the two main exploration areas
connectors.note: Player is explicitly told to fast travel between areas when stuck; white lines on map mark locked traversal points that require the other area's ability
